free_tier.stated: A 7-day free test of a cloud server, requested through an online form, on a ladder whose smallest plan is KZT 3,100 a month for 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 25 GB NVMe in Almaty, Astana or Karaganda.

retention.stated: The free window is seven days and is granted on application rather than on signup, so nothing accumulates and the clock starts only when sales approves.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: KZT 3,100 a month for 1 vCPU and 1 GiB is roughly USD 6, which puts the Kazakh market at the same price floor as the cheapest European VPS, with a seven-day free look before any commitment.

evidence.proved: the cloud server page lists, in Russian, Cloud 1-1-25 with 25 GB NVMe, 1 GB RAM, 1 vCPU and 1 IP address at KZT 3,100 a month, and Cloud 1-2-50 with 50 GB NVMe, 2 GB RAM and 1 vCPU at KZT 4,800 a month, in Almaty, Astana and Karaganda
the provider's own knowledge base states, in Russian, that configurations can be ordered with an online request for a free test of the service of up to 7 days

a Kazakhstan price comparison dated 2026-08-28 gives Hoster.kz at KZT 3,100 a month with 7 free days, PS.kz at KZT 3,120 with a refund in the first 14 days rather than a free server, AdminVPS.kz at KZT 3,235 with 7 free days, and Serverspace with a welcome bonus whose size is shown only after registration

notes: The Kazakh market's free lane is uniformly seven days by application: Hoster.kz, AdminVPS.kz and oblako.kz all run it, and PS.kz offers a 14-day refund instead of a free server. That is the finding: there is no perpetual free tier in Kazakhstan, only a week-long look. The comparison page notes that Serverspace's bonus size is only shown after registration, which makes it unquotable.
